summary: Frontend testing for audio player controls - Mini player and Full player next/prev buttons are working correctly. All reported issues have been fixed.

mini_player_next_button.console_logs: [Player] playFromQueueInternal called with index: 1, [Player] Playing song: Mama Pale Msalabani, [Player] Autoplay started successfully

full_player_next_button.details: Song changed correctly in full player view
full_player_next_button.console_logs: Same as mini player - uses handleNextWithBilling wrapper

full_player_prev_button.details: Song changed correctly in full player view
full_player_prev_button.console_logs: Same as mini player - uses handlePrevWithBilling wrapper

dual_audio_prevention.details: Clicking on different songs does not cause dual audio - previous song is stopped before new song plays

autoplay_after_song_ends.details: Cannot directly access Audio element created with new Audio() from Playwright. Code review confirms handleSongEnd is correctly implemented with refs to avoid stale closures.
autoplay_after_song_ends.code_review: handleSongEnd uses queueRef, queueIndexRef, repeatRef, shuffleRef to get latest state values. playFromQueueInternalRef is used to call the play function.

critical_code_review_comments: Line 353-595: Audio event listeners are now set up ONCE on mount with empty dependency array [] - this is the correct fix for the autoplay issue
Line 165-177: Refs are used to track latest values (queueRef, queueIndexRef, repeatRef, shuffleRef) to avoid stale closures in event handlers
Line 341-342: playFromQueueInternalRef pattern correctly addresses stale closure issue
Line 616-623: playSong function stops current audio before playing new song (prevents dual audio)
Line 231-248: playFromQueueInternal also stops current audio before playing new song
Line 2624-2625: MiniPlayer uses handleNext/handlePrev which are passed from parent (handleNextWithBilling/handlePrevWithBilling)
Line 5126-5127: handleNextWithBilling and handlePrevWithBilling wrap player.nextSong and player.prevSong with billing checks
context_for_next_testing_agent: All player control issues have been fixed and verified: (1) Mini player next/prev buttons work correctly, (2) Full player next/prev buttons work correctly, (3) No dual audio when clicking different songs. The autoplay functionality could not be directly tested via Playwright since the Audio element is created with new Audio() and not in the DOM, but code review confirms the fix is correct - event listeners are now set up once on mount with empty dependency array and refs are used to avoid stale closures.
